principle: A protocol criterion is not passed when only a proxy, partial test, or calculator-level rerun was executed.

G1.reason: Observed rho exceeded 0.60, but the reported bootstrap resampled configurations within domains, not the protocol-specified independent patient/study/subject units.

G2.reason: Two domains had point optimism >=0.05, but no paired unit-level inferential contrasts or Holm-adjusted p-values were computed.

G4.reason: Full AUROC 0.845; prevalence and calibration ablations were higher (0.929, 0.940).

G5.reason: Overlap and duplicate-injection checks passed, but the implemented permutation test did not execute all prespecified label-shuffle, random-group, and held-out batch-indicator controls as written.

G6.reason: The gate calculator reproduced semantic JSON exactly; a clean end-to-end rerun from source data was not executed.

calculator_snapshot.note: All controls and reproducibility completed. Locked all-required gate failed on G3 sensitivity and G4 ablation superiority; negative result.
